title: A bot keeps an internal to-do board independent of project boards
description:
As a Chatticus bot user, I want ongoing bot work tracked separately from a specific project so project context does not swallow internal commitments.

Proposed acceptance behavior for future implementation; not executable proof or a delivery claim.

```gherkin
Feature: Internal bot boards
  Scenario: Record work with no project board selected
    Given an internal bot board has been authorized for my scope
    And no project board is selected
    When the bot records a to-do item through the approved issue tool
    Then the item belongs to the internal bot board
    And no project filesystem board is changed
  Scenario: Switch board kinds
    Given I am permitted to inspect an internal board and a project board
    When I switch between them
    Then each view identifies its board and board kind
    And issues from one board are not silently mixed into the other
```

Design/acceptance questions before implementation: Resolve bot/user/organization/account ownership and whether multiple bots share a board. Which issue tools and user visibility/edit controls apply? Must reads and updates work on a computerless worker? Preserve capability-based readiness; do not require a project filesystem by accident. Retain the shared @kanbus/ui presentation.
right_now_summary: The team is defining separate internal bot boards without mixing them with project boards.
